_note: Benchmark candidates. 40 profiles across 6 professional areas (IT 10, Marketing 6, Finance & Accounting 6, HR 6, Design 6, Operations 6), including the eleven diagnostic fixtures (ten plus `vocabulary-gap`). Every structured skill name is verified against fixtures/vocabulary.txt (regenerated from the skill seed migrations by build_vocabulary.py). Tenure is expressed as real startDate/endDate pairs and is intended to be read against today=2026-08-27; endDate null means ongoing. The `area` field is BOOKKEEPING ONLY and carries no grading authority - it records the area the candidate is SEEKING work in, which is not necessarily where their history is, and the runner uses it to group listings for the diagnostic tables. Grades follow evidence, never the tag (rubric.md sections 3.1 and 8.4); it-cross-domain-1 and dsg-career-changer-1 disagree with their tags on purpose. `pairedWith` is a lab-only field used by the skill-superset diagnostic to locate its twin.
